# Quaternius Medieval Village MegaKit (Standard)

- Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/medievalvillagemegakit.html
- Creator: Quaternius (@Quaternius)
- Edition: Standard / free edition
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication)
- Project use: modular buildings, village landmarks, props, ground dressing, and environmental storytelling for the main 3D map.

The original `License_Standard.txt` is retained in the `License` directory. Models and textures are kept under `Models` and `Textures`; generated Unity `.meta` files and project-side stylized materials are maintained separately by Unity and `PrototypeSceneBuilder`.
